test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error.

The worlds you and I belong to are very __defferent.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"defferent"** is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling is **"different"**, which means not the same as another or each other. (अलग)
 
 
• **Example: **The worlds you and I belong to are very different.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **different.**
